text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, I'm working at my desk, when...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
U-um! P-p-please help! It's Opera O...
There's
something terribly wrong with
her!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Urgh... I don't think I've ever seen her not smiling! Whatever's going on, it can't be good!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She has a point. Even from a distance,
it's clear
that T.M. Opera O is far from
her usual self.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Neath the stillness of a wintry sky do I
espy
Stars gleaming o'er the gallant
Overlord

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what is she saying? Now I'm even
more
confused...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Alas! It's no good... I wish to exude
composure,
yet my beauteous
form—draped in
ultramarine—brings me
naught but joy!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
So... She left to go change, but she
looks just as
troubled as before! Ohhh,
what is going on,
Opera O?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! No way!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
Oh, it's you, Doto. I thought I
heard your voice.
And you've my courtly
trainer with you!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eeek! I'm s-s-so sorry! I didn't mean to
snoop!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ha ha ha! What is there to apologize
for? It's only
natural you'd be drawn to
this new allure of mine!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Why, I speak of this heretofore unseen
side of
myself, brought out by my
heretofore unseen
outfit!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I am radiant as the sun, 'tis true. But am I
not also
beautiful, thus, overflowing with
serene and
gallant grace?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! You gaze upon the deep
aquamarine of a
breaking dawn as it
graces the New Year's sky!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
The winter sky of New Year's day?
Th-that's so
deep! That's Opera O for
you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I ask her if she's trying to search for a
new side of
herself that will suit her new
outfit, and she nods.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Quick on the uptake as ever! Indeed, I
was
seeking precisely that...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And in the midst of my search, who
should appear
but you, Doto! This is no
mere happenstance, I'm
quite certain!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You are always enveloped in a blue
aura... and I
do believe I shall take this
opportunity to learn
from your brave
and melancholic bearing!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wha?! M-me?! I-I'm not really sure what
I can do,
but I'm happy to be of service!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I assume you too are willing to lend your
aid.
Well, Trainer? Where should I
begin?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Impersonation? I see! I can embody her
spirit by
first imitating her movements!
With my talents as
a thespian, this will
take no time at all!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...!
Well? What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-o-oh my! Umm, well...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I believe your melancholic expression
looks
something like... this! Ngh! I need
to make it more
heartbreaking, more
beautiful...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: More... More blue!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Through some trial and error, T.M.
Opera O
seems to have learned
something from how
Meisho Doto carries
herself.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hm... In that case, I'd like to see
Doto—brimming
with gallantry and
gloom—in a more natural state.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A more natural state... So I just need to
act
normal? O-o-okay, I can do that!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Just so! I appreciate your cooperation.
Worry not
about my presence—I shall
observe you from the
shadows like a
phantom anon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, I find T.M. Opera O
watching
Meisho Doto in affected
secrecy.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I am the phantom of the Overlord!
Here I
stand, an angel of the shadows,
to clandestinely
gaze upon thee!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaagh! Again?! I-it's nerve-racking
being
watched like this!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eurgh!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Doto! Are you all right?!
Phew, it
appears you're uninjured.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
But how awe-inspiring... The way in
which you fell
and cried out... That was
truly magnificent!
You've taught me
much!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
U-uh... This is more than I can take!
Aaah!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, a futile endeavor! One cannot
outrun a
specter!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Meisho Doto finds herself
haunted for
several days...
